steps.content: You wrench your leg free, stumbling back. Horne's frantic breaths hitch, and his face contorts, features dissolving into something monstrous.

steps.speaker: Horne
steps.content: Unbelievable... This is just unbelievable! I was only gathering intelligence... and this is how you all treat me...
His furious roar is swallowed by a wave of violent Mania. Pitch-black, sludge-like energy erupts from his core, consuming him in an instant.

steps.speaker: Horne
steps.content: How dare you all corner me... I never meant for this... Such rotten luck... I just wanted to see it for myself... Have something to boast about when I get back...

steps.speaker: Horne
steps.content: Why can't I leave... I'm NOT a traitor! Let me go... just let me go...

steps.speaker: Marlo
steps.content: Holy ****, what the hell is that thing?!
Marlo doesn't think. Pure, primal instinct takes over. He raises his pistol and fires.
Your proximity to Horne has placed you directly in the line of fire—both from Marlo's frantic barrage and the Corruptor's twisting waves of Mania.

A warm trickle of blood snakes down your temple. A deep, pervasive cold begins to seep into your limbs, and the chaotic screams around you melt into a distant, muffled hum. Your vision blurs, only making out shapes of people scrambling and fleeing the monstrous form the Corruptor has become.
Through the high-pitched ringing dominating your hearing, a voice fights its way through. Someone is at your side, shaking you and calling your name with panic...

steps.speaker: Edward
steps.content: ${PlayerName}! Officer! Officer, stay with me! What am I supposed to do if you die—
As the last of your consciousness bleeds away, a final, ironic thought flickers: of all the possible faces to see at the end... it just had to be Edward's...
